annotationRationale: The question combines speed, payment per mile, fuel efficiency, and price per gallon. Decimal multiplication supports calculating earnings. Whole-trip calculations are equivalent scalings of this hourly route.

classificationReview.areaCheck: Prealgebra is appropriate; no area repair is needed.

review.questionCheck: Independently, the trip covers 120 miles, earns $60, and consumes 4 gallons costing $8. Net hourly pay is (60−8)/2=$26, choice E. The stem, choices, and key agree; no figures or grading contradictions are supplied.
review.alternativeMethodCheck: 2020_AMC_10A_Q04 / compute-hourly-amounts was independently checked against this identical problem and retained. LIVE and AoPS Solution 2 use whole-trip totals, an equivalent scaling of the hourly route rather than a beneficial additional method.
review.annotationCheck: cnm_p111 appropriately assesses combining speed, fuel efficiency, unit price, and earnings relationships. cnm_p134 supports the decimal payment calculation. Empty contextual roles are appropriate.
review.areaCheck: Prealgebra is appropriate; no area repair is needed.

methodReviews.mathCheck: Hourly gross earnings are 60(0.50)=$30. Hourly fuel consumption is 60/30=2 gallons, costing $4. Subtracting gives $26 per hour. Constant stated rates justify working directly per hour.
methodReviews.sourceMethodCheck: The retained explanation matches 2020_AMC_10A_Q04#compute-hourly-amounts and its methodLocalSources provenance. sourceRefIds includes both the reviewed-project reference and its inherited live-reference-2020_AMC_10A_Q04 credit. Project reuse and the nonofficial source-informed-original basis are honestly identified.
methodReviews.pedagogyCheck: The first sentence motivates hourly quantities, and the explanation shows how miles per gallon determines gallons consumed. Units make the rate combinations reconstructible.
methodReviews.directNodeCheck: cnm_p111 covers the price, quantity, and speed relationships used. cnm_p134 directly supports multiplying mileage by the decimal payment rate.
